text_block_list.text:
Our challenge in the Twinkle Series 
alongside Mihono Bourbon is finally 
beginning in earnest!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Our primary goal in the Twinkle Series is 
to "achieve the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To achieve our objective, I request 
progressive and continuous physical 
conditioning.
choice_data_list: Of course! Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.text:
To achieve the Triple Crown, and to prove 
that 'stamina can be compensated for 
through sheer effort'—

The days of working hand-in-hand on 
intensive training had begun!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah!

As she diligently trained with great 
focus, a figure watched her from afar.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Bourbon-san. You're amazing as 
always today— that training looks super 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You're running the slope course six 
times every day, right? It's enough to 
make someone worry...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!
choice_data_list:
Keep it up, just one more lap back and 
forth!

Keep it up, just one more lap back and 
forth!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much... again today, 
Master..."
choice_data_list: You worked so hard again today, huh.

You worked so hard again today, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No... I am merely carrying out the 
training menu provided by Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rather than praise my own efforts for 
this, it is Master's hard work that 
deserves credit.
choice_data_list: No, it's all thanks to your hard work.
No, it's all thanks to your hard work.

text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's training regimen is 
structured to be considerably harder 
compared to other Umamusume.

There are probably few Umamusume who could 
handle this thoroughly without a single 
complaint.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

The cheeks of Mihono Bourbon, usually so 
expressionless, softened ever so slightly.
choice_data_list:
Let's give it our all in the Twinkle 
Series!

Let's do our best in the Twinkle Series, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

"The hardcore training is definitely 
building up her strength."

As I headed toward the Trainer's Room to 
further refine the training regimen—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Got a second?
A colleague called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Mihono Bourbon... Is it really 
okay for her to be doing such intense 
stamina training?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Even if you say I can pull it off...
He scratched his head, looking troubled.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...She's unnaturally obedient to her 
Trainer. I've even heard rumors that 
they're taking advantage of it."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's probably a natural sprinter at 
heart. I'm begging you, don't break a 
talented Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's true.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Achieving the Triple Crown was originally 
the cherished ambition of my father and 
me. Master is pursuing that dream 
alongside us.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Master's meticulous training, my 
cardiopulmonary endurance is steadily 
improving.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Aside from training to consistently run 
medium and long distances in stable times—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The other day, she recorded a time of 1 
minute 35.5 seconds over 1600 meters. For 
the Junior Class, that's a time that can 
certainly hold its own in a race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I presume this outcome was born from 
Master believing in the strength of my 
body.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, my mind and body are 
currently in optimal condition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In other words, to sum it up: "It's fine."

Mihono Bourbon delivered the entire 
sentence in practically a single breath, 
leaving her peer completely stunned.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
... Haha, I didn't expect you to be the 
one persuading me so hard.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't 'persuasion.' I merely conveyed 
the 'facts.'"

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah. Got it, my bad. That was 
uncalled for.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I was just a little worried you were being 
forced to run against your will.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you seem to have immense faith in 
them. Take care not to get hurt in the 
Twinkle Series. I'll be cheering for you.”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
Saying that, my colleague walked away.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not understand the intention behind 
your gratitude. I merely corrected a 
misunderstanding.
choice_data_list: I was glad to know they believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not really knowledgeable about 
that sort of thing."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I have determined that Master's 
instructions are indispensable in order to 
enter long-distance races.
choice_data_list: That just shows how much they trust you.
That just shows how much they trust you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see... So this is it.

And so, the days of chasing dreams 
together with Mihono Bourbon began!
